sections.heading: Use the equipment and symptom together
paragraphs: The full model and heating method determine which advice applies. The linked pages provide different routes for maintenance, heating failure, water flow, discharge and controls. A guide supports identification and a useful enquiry; it does not replace competent system assessment.

sections.heading: Further areas retained from the existing website
paragraphs: The current site also names Westminster, Mayfair, Marylebone, Paddington, Bayswater, Notting Hill, Chiswick, Battersea, Clapham, Wandsworth, Twickenham, Hampstead, Camden, Highgate and Islington. Selected attendance elsewhere is discussed by postcode; no unverified office addresses or brand-installation density claims are made.
